change: Applied TCP_NODELAY to accepted sockets only; ran a full paired benchmark.
evidence: Small persistent 256-client p99 was 5.1ms versus 44.5ms and median was 171996 versus 5954 rps, but all workloads were generator-ineligible; large persistent throughput fell, and the challenger had 921 failures at 4096 clients. Neither performance nor reliability promotion gates were met.
hypothesis: TCP_NODELAY prevents the small persistent response delayed-ACK stall.
next_action: With insufficient time for another full matrix, investigate a bounded disconnect-handling defect and revalidate the retained server.
verdict: Unpromoted; result is inconclusive, not a general speedup.
